name: io.github.tonyyang0504/tradera-mcp
description: Tradera (automotive): get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADERA_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application ID (integer) of an app registered in the Tradera Developer Center (self-service).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADERA_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Application key (GUID) of that app. Read-only calls (search, items, categories) need only these two headers.
